reviews.text: An amazing clinic; they have always taken very, very good care of my Bernese Mountain Dog. I recommend them 100%.

Dr. Cléroux is the best vet we’ve ever had. She has been caring for our senior beagle for the past year, and we couldn’t be more grateful to have her.

She always makes thoughtful decisions about our girl’s care and is incredibly patient with her. Our beagle was diagnosed with CHF over six months ago, and I honestly couldn’t imagine navigating this condition with anyone else.

Dr. Cléroux is compassionate, knowledgeable, and genuinely cares about her patients. She is always responsive to our calls and emails and makes us feel supported whenever we have questions or concerns.
Thank you for your positive feedback.

I have nothing but praise for the wonderful team at the Ontario branch. My cat had an intestinal blockage, and we were very worried about him. Throughout the various stages of his diagnosis, surgery, and recovery, I had a dedicated, empathetic, and responsive team doing everything they could to save my cat. Dr. Cléroux, in particular, supported and advised me with compassion and understanding. Today, Chopin is slowly recovering and has found his vet for life.
